name: rice_disease
deployment_status: APPROVED for first-pass screening behind the confidence gate.

training_data.rice: Paddy Doctor via Kaggle (10,407 smartphone field images, 10 classes including normal) plus 65% of the Mendeley 'Rice Leaf Disease Image Samples' set (fwcj7stb8r). Both deduplicated by content hash before splitting; 11,896 training images.

evaluation.reported_accuracy_meaning: Accuracy of predictions ACTUALLY SHOWN to a farmer, i.e. those that clear the on-device confidence gate. This is the number that matters, because nothing else reaches the user.
evaluation.coverage_meaning: 44.4% of photos are answered on device; the other 55.6% are escalated to cloud diagnosis or returned inconclusive.
evaluation.in_domain_note: Paddy Doctor held-out validation, 10 classes, deduplicated.
evaluation.same_collection_test_note: Mendeley slice B, 1,677 images, hash-disjoint from training. It is the SAME COLLECTION as part of the training data and covers only 4 of the 10 classes, so it is NOT a cross-collection estimate and must not be quoted as one.
evaluation.healthy_leaves_shown_a_disease_label: 0 of 18 (gate-filtered); raw model errs on 37% of healthy leaves, all of which the gate escalates
evaluation.leakage_check: PASSED. check_leakage.py verified zero hash overlap between train, val and test, and zero duplicates within any split.

split_rule: Deduplicated by MD5 before splitting so no duplicate can straddle a boundary. Enforced by check_leakage.py, which aborts training.
limitations: Rice only. The other 13 crops in the AgriN registry are unsupported and are routed to cloud diagnosis by the coverage gate.

NO cross-collection accuracy estimate exists. Both evaluation sets come from collections that also contributed training data. Real field performance in an unseen region is unmeasured and should be assumed lower.
Trained on Indian imagery (Tamil Nadu and Bangladesh-region collections). Performance elsewhere is unknown.
Answers only 44% of photos. The rest need connectivity for cloud diagnosis, or return inconclusive offline.
Raw accuracy is 0.786; the 0.981 figure holds ONLY with the confidence gate in place. Deploying these weights without the gate would be unsafe.
bacterial_leaf_blight is the weakest class in the raw model (0.500) and is bacterial, so a fungicide would not help even when correct.
intended_use: First-pass screening on a farmer's phone, behind the coverage and confidence gate in app/ai/disease.py, with expert review advised.
not_intended_for: Unsupervised treatment decisions, regulatory use, or any deployment without the confidence gate.
license: Apache-2.0 (weights); source datasets keep their own licences.

rejected_strategies: int8 with uint8 I/O - artifact failed allocate_tensors ('Node 119 failed to prepare'); MobileNetV3 hard-swish and squeeze-excite do not survive an int8-only op set
int8 weights with float activations - same failure
quantisation.note: Each candidate is loaded and run once before acceptance.
